title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Matthew 4: the temptation in the wilderness, the move to Capernaum, and the calling of the first fishermen.

questions.text: Where was Jesus led by the Spirit to be tempted by the devil?
questions.explanation: Matthew 4:1 says Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

questions.text: How long did Jesus fast before he was hungry?
questions.explanation: He had fasted forty days and forty nights, and afterward he was hungry.

questions.text: What did the tempter tell Jesus to command the stones to become?
questions.explanation: The tempter said that if he was the Son of God, he should command that the stones become bread.

questions.text: According to Jesus' answer, by what does man live besides bread?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered that man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God's mouth.

questions.text: Where did the devil set Jesus when he took him into the holy city?
questions.explanation: The devil took him into the holy city and set him on the pinnacle of the temple.

answers.text: Beside the altar of the temple
On the pinnacle of the temple
At the gate of the palace
On the wall of the city

questions.text: What did the devil offer Jesus on the exceedingly high mountain?
questions.explanation: The devil showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory, and offered them if Jesus would fall down and worship him.

answers.text: All the kingdoms of the world and their glory
Bread from the stones of the wilderness
Command over all the angels of heaven
The throne of Galilee and Judea

questions.text: What happened after the devil left Jesus?
questions.explanation: The devil left him, and angels came and served him.

answers.text: A great light shone over the sea
The report about him reached Syria
The temple was shut against him

questions.text: Which town did Jesus live in after he left Nazareth?
questions.explanation: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea.

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the two fishermen Simon and Andrew?
questions.explanation: He told them to come after him, and he would make them fishers for men.

answers.text: Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men
Go and tell no one what you have seen
Mend your nets and wait for me in Nazareth
Sell your boat and give the money away

questions.text: What did Jesus do in the synagogues as he went about all Galilee?
questions.explanation: He went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom.

answers.text: Read the writings of Isaiah the prophet
Chose twelve men to be his apostles
Taught and preached the Good News of the Kingdom
